content.short: MFL is a play-and-earn football (soccer) management game.
content.description: MFL is a play-and-earn football (soccer) management game that centers on progressive player development and competitive leagues. By leveraging blockchain technology and NFTs, it delivers a more immersive, user-driven experience where clubs and players are owned as NFTs that influence development, strategy, and finances. Users manage clubs, guide player progression, and compete in a dynamic, player-driven economy, where ownership shapes growth, outcomes, and financial potential.
